canonical_project: Chuandong / East Sichuan Big Data Center (川东大数据中心)
owner: China Telecom Sichuan / Dazhou municipal partners
notes: Open and operating with Sugon, Alibaba Cloud, Baidu data-labeling among tenants; opened Nov 2022, RMB1bn total investment, 60 mu site, 800 phase-1 racks and 3,000 phase-2 planned racks, PUE under 1.25, 32T egress bandwidth.
